mentions.name: Assets — Personal Wealth Tracker
mentions.description: This app is a self-hosted net worth and portfolio manager. It tracks multiple portfolios (ISA, General, Pension, Crypto, etc.), monitors individual or total performance, supports any asset available via the Yahoo Finance API, and automatically converts values to the user's base major currency.
